label: Assumed Default
definition: Data could be improved by setting an empty value to a default value.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement are absent and may be proposed to be filled in with a default value. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Completeness.

label: Converted
definition: Data could be improved by converting from one representation to another.
notes: As in spatial coordinate transformations. Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement that do not conform to some specification may be proposed to be replaced with a conforming value. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Conformance.

label: Fill In From
definition: Data could be improved by using one data value to fill in the empty value in another.
notes: As in filling in from verbatim terms. Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement are absent and may be proposed to be filled in by interpretation of values in one or more other terms. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Completeness.

label: Standardized
definition: Data could be improved by conforming them to a standard representation.
notes: Data in a bdqffdq:InformationElement that do not conform to some format, syntax, data type, or standard may be proposed to be replaced with a conforming value. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Conformance.

label: Transposed
definition: Data could be improved by switching values between two or more fields.
notes: Data in a set of at least two bdqffdq:InformationElements that do not conform to expectations may be proposed to have their values switched in order to produce conforming values. Corresponding dimension is bdqdim:Consistency.
